core_job: Once a day, the user opens one finished edition and is done. It shows weather and air quality where they wake up, compared with yesterday (Open-Meteo past_days=1). It lists only the stories that are new since their last brief, each shown once however many outlets carry it. Ongoing stories are marked Day N. Hard news is capped at a level the user sets, and a few bright stories are included. Everything runs on the device with no account. The user is someone who reads news and checks the weather every morning, has already seen yesterday's headlines, and has about five minutes.
signature:
The Since-Yesterday Edition. Each morning the app builds a dated edition on the device and stores it, then compares it with the stored editions from the last 7 days:
- Headlines from different outlets about the same story become one item ("BBC, NPR, DW +1"), matched by title Jaccard >= 0.3.
- Stories that match nothing earlier lead as "New since your last brief".
- Stories that match an earlier edition get a "Day N" badge and a story-thread view showing the headline from each day.
- A story whose publisher URL was already shown is dropped.
- A sky band reads like "1.5° warmer than yesterday, air worse than this time yesterday".
Editions are archived on the device for 30 days, with search and share. Evidence: a prototype on live BBC, Al Jazeera, NPR, DW and Sky feeds (2026-10-12) found 14 cross-outlet matches at 0.3, all 14 the same story by my reading. Open-Meteo forecast and air-quality calls with past_days=1 were curl-verified (HTTP 200). Competitor gap: based on App Store descriptions only (iTunes Lookup: Morning Brief – Routine, DayStart AI, Morning Brief: 5 Min News, Scout, Good News Every Morning). None of them claims cross-day story continuity or deltas against yesterday. Competitor behaviour is not verified, because WebSearch is disabled.

Remove login, signup, auth_service, supabase_config, app_env, the Sign in with Apple entitlement (edit Runner.entitlements only, never the dirty pbxproj), the assistant and its dead OpenAI path, Person Intelligence, Trending, and the always-empty Notifications screen and badge. Remove the fabricated mockups bundled in assets/images ('Traffic is light… first meeting in 2 hours', persona Alex), the AAPL/TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT/NVDA default watchlist, and the hard-coded '1.0.0 (Build 1)'. Acceptance is grep and binary `strings` checks.

M2 Signature: a pure edition_builder module. It clusters stories across outlets (Jaccard >= 0.3), tracks continuity and Day N over 7 days, drops already-seen URLs, and orders the sections (New since your last brief, Still developing, Bright side, Your topics, end card). It builds one edition per local day, and a refresh later the same day appends 'Since this morning'. Includes a story-thread screen. Tests use a committed fixture of real headlines, including one false-positive pair that must not cluster.

M3 Sky band from Open-Meteo past_days=1: delta sentences for temperature against yesterday, AQI against the same hour yesterday, rain chance and sunrise. Settings for °C/°F and EU/US AQI. A clause is omitted when its value is missing. Boundary tests cover the wording.

M4 Rewrite the tone classifier. Today it uses substring matching (news_service.dart:844,847), so 'new' and 'first' count as positive and 'war' matches 'software'. The rewrite uses whole-word matching with ambiguous words removed and returns the matched words. Add the setting 'Hard news in my morning: None / Up to 3 / All' with a folded overflow line. Each card shows a 'why' note. Bright side and Alerts views use the new classifier.

M5 Depth: an Archive tab with 30 editions, cross-edition search and edition count. A Saved tab with search and a tone filter. Share today's edition or a single story as plain text through share_plus. Offline states: the stored edition is shown with an offline banner, an honest message appears when there is no edition yet, a partial build says 'Built from N of M sources', plus weather and city states.

M6 A new shell and onboarding. Three tabs: Today, Archive, Saved (CupertinoTabBar on iOS). The newspaper-order Today screen has a masthead with edition number, date and city, and no name greeting, emoji or FAB. The glance line shows at most 5 symbols as text only (the ApexMarketWatch boundary). Topics replace the assistant. Onboarding has 3 steps: city, hard-news level, optional topics, ending with 'Build my first edition'. No AglAdBanner in the shell; at most two inline banners. The interstitial is removed pending a founder decision.

M7 Identity 'First Light'. ThemeMode.system. Light: surface #F2F5F9, ink #14202B, seed #2F5D8A, apricot accent #F2A65A. Dark: surface #0F1720, text #E6EDF3, primary #7FA7CF. Tone colours: bright #2E8B6E, hard #A63D40. Fonts Newsreader (headlines) and Figtree (UI), bundled as OFL TTFs, with google_fonts removed. 8px corners and hairline rules. A hand-built rising-sun-over-newsprint icon. A new splash on #F2F5F9 whose storyboard shasum differs from 3f6a9b27d8…. Neon hexes and ThemeMode.dark grep to 0.

M8 Honest and proven. Settings → Sources names every feed. No 'AI', 'coming soon', 'not connected' or 'simulator' strings. flutter analyze is clean and all tests pass, with new tests for the edition builder, tone, sky deltas, archive, offline, share, onboarding, shell and glance line, and an extended release_sanity_test. Tests are removed only together with the code they cover, each listed in the commit message. The screenshot test is rewritten with no persona and no QA login.
